comment: P7 native-image metadata. The storages-ce-sdk builds its HTTP client with Retrofit, which
creates a JDK dynamic proxy per service interface (Retrofit.create -> Proxy.newProxyInstance).
GraalVM must know these proxy interfaces at build time; otherwise the first call fails at
runtime with MissingReflectionRegistrationError. StoragesClientImp uses Filestore (blob
bulkDelete via NodeDataFetcher/FilestoreProducer), Checks (liveness) and Config.
